title: The weak limit is minimizing in ℝ^P (Simon 7.2.4 (8))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. For j ∈ ℕ let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P be any sets and S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j), and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity. Assume (1) for every r ∈ ℝ, closedBall(0, r) ⊆ U_j for all sufficiently large j; (2) S_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly); (3) (local comparison) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are an open W with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) and a strictly increasing φ' : ℕ → ℕ such that limsup_i M_W(S_{ψ(φ'(i))}) ≤ M_W(S) for every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with SameBoundary S C (∂S = ∂C if n ≥ 1, vacuous if n = 0) and spt(S − C) ⊆ K. Then C is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ): C is integer multiplicity, and M_W(C) ≤ M_W(S) whenever W ⊆ ℝ^P is open with closure W compact (CompactlyContained W ℝ^P), S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity, SameBoundary S C, spt(S − C) is compact and spt(S − C) ⊆ ℝ^P ∩ W. Notation: 𝒟_n(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V n; 𝒟ⁿ(V) = TestFormOn V n (smooth compactly supported n-forms ω on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ V); for Y ∈ 𝒟_n(V) and any O ⊆ ℝ^P, M_O(Y) := Y.massOn O = sup{ofReal(Y(ω)) : ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V), tsupport ω ⊆ O, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} ∈ [0, ∞] (SimonGMT massOn, |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors); currentEval(Y, ω) := Y(ω) if ω is a test form with tsupport ω ⊆ V and 0 otherwise; S_j ⇀ C (ConvergesWeakly Ss C) means currentEval(S_j, ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); thickening(ε, K) = {x : inf_{y∈K} |x − y| < ε}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W) → IsMinimizingIn C univ
